raw.overview: All three advisors concur that the supplier's rebate structure fails to guarantee the required $15,000 savings across the entire 950-1,050 unit demand band, as volumes below 1,000 units (950-999) yield $0 rebate despite the constraint demanding minimum savings at all volumes within the specified range.
raw.points_of_note: The critical issue centers on the $0 rebate for volumes 950-999 units, which directly violates the constraint requiring >= $15,000 savings at any volume in the 950-1,050 band; Advisor 1 notes the cliff structure with $20/unit retroactive credit only applying at 1,000+ units, Advisor 2 emphasizes the 999-unit threshold violation, and Advisor 3 confirms Schedule C's explicit $0 rebate for 999 units or fewer while noting the maximum $21,000 rebate at 1,050 units does not resolve the minimum guarantee failure.
raw.suggested_next_step: Verify with the supplier whether the 1,000-unit threshold applies to all units or only incremental units above 1,000 to determine if a revised rebate structure can guarantee the $15,000 minimum across the full 950-1,050 unit band.

consensus.text:
ASSESSMENT OVERVIEW: All three advisors concur that the supplier's rebate structure fails to guarantee the required $15,000 savings across the entire 950-1,050 unit demand band, as volumes below 1,000 units (950-999) yield $0 rebate despite the constraint demanding minimum savings at all volumes within the specified range.
POINTS OF NOTE: The critical issue centers on the $0 rebate for volumes 950-999 units, which directly violates the constraint requiring >= $15,000 savings at any volume in the 950-1,050 band; Advisor 1 notes the cliff structure with $20/unit retroactive credit only applying at 1,000+ units, Advisor 2 emphasizes the 999-unit threshold violation, and Advisor 3 confirms Schedule C's explicit $0 rebate for 999 units or fewer while noting the maximum $21,000 rebate at 1,050 units does not resolve the minimum guarantee failure.
SUGGESTED NEXT STEP: Verify with the supplier whether the 1,000-unit threshold applies to all units or only incremental units above 1,000 to determine if a revised rebate structure can guarantee the $15,000 minimum across the full 950-1,050 unit band.
